records.jp: ……やっぱり、<CR>ああいう舞台を見ると少し思い出しちゃうな
records.en_original: Seeing this kind of stage really takes me back...
records.en_auxiliary: Seeing this kind of stage really takes me back...
records.en: ...As I thought,<CR>seeing a stage like that brings some memories back.

records.jp: バレエのこと、だよね？
records.en_original: You mean it makes you think of ballet?
records.en_auxiliary: You mean it makes you think of ballet?
records.en: You mean it makes you think of ballet?

records.jp: うん。昔はよく、ああいう場所でバレエしてたなって
records.en_original: Yeah. I often used to do ballet in places like this.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. I often used to do ballet in places like this.
records.en: Yeah. I often used to do ballet in places like this.

records.jp: ……あんまり思い出したくない記憶だったりする？
records.en_original: Would you rather not think about those memories?
records.en_auxiliary: Would you rather not think about those memories?
records.en: Would you rather not think about those memories?

records.jp: いや、そんなことはないよ。<CR>今となっては、それも全部いい思い出だからね
records.en_original: No, it's not that at all. Even now I still consider them some of my best memories.
records.en_auxiliary: No, it's not that at all. Even now I still consider them some of my best memories.
records.en: No, not at all.<CR>They're all good memories now.

records.jp: すごいな、日菜子さんは……。<CR>ちゃんと過去と向き合ってて
records.en_original: I think you're awesome, Hinako. Being able to face your past like that...
records.en_auxiliary: I think you're awesome, Hinako. Being able to face your past like that...
records.en: I think you're awesome, Hinako-san.<CR>Being able to face your past like that...

records.jp: 私はあんまり、大きな挫折とか経験したことないから、<CR>想像することしかできないけど……
records.en_original: I've never experienced any big setbacks in my life, so I can't begin to imagine what it's like...
records.en_auxiliary: I've never experienced any big setbacks in my life, so I can't begin to imagine what it's like...
records.en: I've never experienced a major setback,<CR>so I can only imagine what that must be like...

records.jp: ……大きい小さいはあるにしても、<CR>ずっと心に残ってるままならない思い出ってあると思う
records.en_original: I think there are things that end up remaining in everyone's heart, no matter how big or small.
records.en_auxiliary: I think there are things that end up remaining in everyone's heart, no matter how big or small.
records.en: Whether large or small,<CR>I think everyone has frustrating memories that remain in their heart.

records.jp: 愛央だって、ちょっとした失敗を<CR>いつまでも覚えてる、みたいなことはあるでしょ？
records.en_original: Even you must have some small failures that you still remember.
records.en_auxiliary: Even you must have some small failures that you still remember.
records.en: Even you must have some<CR>small failures that you still remember.

records.jp: まあ、たしかに……
records.en_original: Yeah, that's true...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, that's true...
records.en: Yeah, that's true...

records.jp: 私だったら……ずっと引きずっちゃうだろうな<CR>
records.en_original: I guess I have a hard time letting things go.
records.en_auxiliary: I guess I have a hard time letting things go.
records.en: If it were me... I think I would dwell on it forever.<CR>

records.jp: あの時こうすれば、とか、<CR>もしこうしなければ今頃……みたいな感じで
records.en_original: I'm always thinking, if only I'd done this differently, or if only I hadn't done that...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm always thinking, if only I'd done this differently, or if only I hadn't done that...
records.en: Thinking, 'If only I had done this then,'<CR>or, 'If I had not done that, by now...'

records.jp: あはは。気持ちはすっごい分かるよ。<CR>私だってたくさんある
records.en_original: Hah. I totally know how you feel. I've felt like that a lot.
records.en_auxiliary: Hah. I totally know how you feel. I've felt like that a lot.
records.en: Hah. I totally know how you feel.<CR>I've felt like that a lot.

records.jp: でも、そうだなぁ……。<CR>それでも私が今、前を向けているのは――
records.en_original: But, despite that... Now I think it's important to always keep looking forward.
records.en_auxiliary: But, despite that... Now I think it's important to always keep looking forward.
records.en: But, despite that...<CR>Now I think it's important to always keep looking forward.

records.jp: 大切だな、大事にしたいなと思うものを<CR>たくさん持つようにしたからかもしれないね
records.en_original: Maybe it's because I've met a lot of people who I really care about and want to protect.
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe it's because I've met a lot of people who I really care about and want to protect.
records.en: Maybe it's because I've found so many things<CR>that feel precious to me and that I want to cherish.

records.jp: 大事にしたいと思うもの、か……
records.en_original: People you want to protect...?
records.en_auxiliary: People you want to protect...?
records.en: Things you want to cherish...

records.jp: うん。ユズやライムだけじゃない。<CR>愛央や詩帆、他のみんなもそう
records.en_original: Yeah. Not just Yuzu and Lime, but you, Shiho, and everyone else.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. Not just Yuzu and Lime, but you, Shiho, and everyone else.
records.en: Yes. Not only Yuzu and Lime.<CR>You, Shiho, and everyone else too.

records.jp: 昔の私はバレエしかなかった。<CR>だからその柱が折れて、バランスを崩しちゃった
records.en_original: Before, all I had was ballet. It was the only thing holding me up, so when I lost it, my life was thrown completely off-balance.
records.en_auxiliary: Before, all I had was ballet. It was the only thing holding me up, so when I lost it, my life was thrown completely off-balance.
records.en: In the past, ballet was all I had.<CR>So when that pillar broke, I lost my balance.

records.jp: でも今はみんなが大切。だからもし、<CR>少し辛いことがあっても、他の柱が支えてくれる
records.en_original: But now, I have all of you. So even if I stumble, I know the people I care about will support me.
records.en_auxiliary: But now, I have all of you. So even if I stumble, I know the people I care about will support me.
records.en: But now, everyone is precious to me. So even if<CR>something hurts a little, the other pillars support me.

records.jp: そういうふうにして、うまいこと<CR>バランスを取っていくしかないんじゃないかな
records.en_original: That's how I keep my balance.
records.en_auxiliary: That's how I keep my balance.
records.en: I think all we can do is find a way<CR>to keep our balance like that.

records.jp: すごい大人な考え……
records.en_original: Wow, how mature...
records.en_auxiliary: Wow, how mature...
records.en: Wow, how mature...

records.jp: う……な、なんかかっこつけたみたいで<CR>恥ずかしくなってきちゃった
records.en_original: Ah... Now I'm embarrassed. I feel like I was trying to sound cool...
records.en_auxiliary: Ah... Now I'm embarrassed. I feel like I was trying to sound cool...
records.en: Ah... Now I'm embarrassed. I feel like I<CR>was trying to sound cool...

records.jp: いいんだよ、こういう時は胸張って！
records.en_original: No, not at all! You should be proud of that!
records.en_auxiliary: No, not at all! You should be proud of that!
records.en: No, not at all! You should be proud of that!

records.jp: 私も見習わないとなぁ、日菜子さんの考え方
records.en_original: I should learn from your philosophy, Hinako.
records.en_auxiliary: I should learn from your philosophy, Hinako.
records.en: I should learn from your philosophy, Hinako-san.

records.jp: 無理に真似しなくてもいいと思うよ？<CR>どういう考え方が合うかは人それぞれだから
records.en_original: You don't have to try to imitate me. Different ways of thinking suit different people.
records.en_auxiliary: You don't have to try to imitate me. Different ways of thinking suit different people.
records.en: You don't have to force yourself to copy me.<CR>Different ways of thinking work for different people.

records.jp: すごい、どんどんかっこいい言葉が出てくるよ
records.en_original: Amazing. The words of wisdom just keep coming...
records.en_auxiliary: Amazing. The words of wisdom just keep coming...
records.en: Amazing. The words of wisdom just keep coming...

records.jp: あはは……ありがと、でいいのかな
records.en_original: Ahaha... A simple "thanks" would suffice.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha... A simple "thanks" would suffice.
records.en: Ahaha... A simple "thanks" would suffice.

records.jp: なるほどなぁ。たくさんの柱で支える、かぁ……
records.en_original: So... I should build a solid foundation with lots of support...
records.en_auxiliary: So... I should build a solid foundation with lots of support...
records.en: So... I should build a solid foundation with lots of support...

records.jp: 私も日菜子さんのこと、<CR>ちゃんと支えてあげられるようにしないと！
records.en_original: I've got to become someone you can really rely on too!
records.en_auxiliary: I've got to become someone you can really rely on too!
records.en: Then I have to make sure<CR>I can properly support you too, Hinako-san!

records.jp: ふふっ、もう十分支えられてるよ
records.en_original: Hehe... You're doing a great job at that already.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe... You're doing a great job at that already.
records.en: Hehe. You already support me more than enough.

records.jp: 私、みんなに「ありがとう」って言ってこようかな！
records.en_original: I've got to properly thank everyone too!
records.en_auxiliary: I've got to properly thank everyone too!
records.en: I've got to properly thank everyone too!

records.jp: ど、どうしたの突然……？
records.en_original: Wh-what, all of a sudden...?
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what, all of a sudden...?
records.en: Wh-what, all of a sudden...?

records.jp: 私も知らず知らずのうちにみんなに<CR>支えられてるんだなーって思って
records.en_original: I just realized that all of you have been supporting me this whole time, without me even noticing!
records.en_auxiliary: I just realized that all of you have been supporting me this whole time, without me even noticing!
records.en: I just realized that all of you have been supporting<CR>me this whole time, without me even noticing!

records.jp: う、うーん……<CR>いきなり言ったら変な人だと思われちゃうかもね……
records.en_original: Well, um... I think you coming out of nowhere and saying that might come off a bit strange...
records.en_auxiliary: Well, um... I think you coming out of nowhere and saying that might come off a bit strange...
records.en: Well, um...<CR>I think you coming out of nowhere and saying that might come off a bit strange...

records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
